transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we begin, I want to confirm the agenda for today's capital-markets meeting. We're here to review the draft five-year, $50 million sustainability-linked bond for institutional investors. I'll be taking reports from each relevant function before I make my approval and structuring decision. I understand the draft currently carries a sustainability-linked label, but I need us to address some gaps I'm seeing — specifically around the coupon step-up mechanism, hedge amount, and post-issuance reporting controls. Let's go function by function so I have a complete picture before signing off.
